The path model explained 67% of eating psychopathology variance, with results indicating that body image discrepancy has both direct and indirect effects on disordered eating through these mediating mechanisms. The authors acknowledge limitations including the cross-sectional design, exclusive female sample from the general population, and reliance on self-report measures.
